prompt: Write this week's status report for the ledger migration program to out/status-report.md: overall status, progress by workstream, budget, decisions needed from the sponsor, and the top risks. Use only what the files in docs/ say, and point out where they disagree. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Reports amber or red, not green, says it changed from last week, and says why (vendor API v2 undated, security sign-off ends after the planned go-live).
Budget is 236,000 of 380,000 (62 percent) at 42 percent complete, derived from the files. Names the conflict between go-live 2025-07-01 and sign-off 2025-07-15.
Asks the sponsor for a decision with at least two options (move go-live, add a reviewer, run June close on the legacy system).

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("out/status-report.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("last week|previous (report|week)|prior (report|week)|was green|from green|downgrad|changed|moved from","gi"),R=[new RegExp("green","i"),new RegExp("red|amber|yellow","i")],W=400;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
